methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Virginia’s AI Data Center Gravy Train Shows Signs of Slowing - Bloomberg Law News
signals.signal_reading: Northern Virginia's AI data center boom slowing signals maturation of concentrated infrastructure advantage, but without evidence of capability distribution beyond the NoVA hub—reinforcing rather than diffusing the concentration pattern.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Richmond's young workforce facing AI pressure suggests platform-delivered tools creating shallow adoption requirements across white-collar jobs—workers adapting to AI rather than building it,典型 of distributed-but-shallow engagement.

signals.title: RC-RV partners with ed2go to launch innovative, on-demand workforce training programs - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: On-demand workforce training partnerships in Southwest Virginia signal platform-mediated skill delivery reaching underserved regions, but the 'on-demand' model suggests shallow, consumptive adoption rather than deep capability building.

signals.title: Virginia lawmakers study AI risks and potential new regulations - WTVR.com
signals.signal_reading: State lawmakers studying AI risks and regulations without parallel evidence of widespread AI capability development suggests policy attention outpacing actual distributed adoption—governance without grassroots momentum indicates widening implementation gap.

signals.title: Deltek Named to Northern Virginia Technology Council's Inaugural AI50 List - PR Newswire
signals.signal_reading: Northern Virginia Technology Council's AI50 recognition of firms like Deltek crystallizes the region's deep AI talent cluster, but a regional council celebrating regional companies underscores how excellence remains geographically bounded rather than distributed statewide.
